name: Medical Fellows
source:
Shimamura Kazito just got a doctor's license. He has never had any interest in girls and his mother and aunt conspired that his medical team would include only beautiful women. Can hero become a fine doctor? Which way will love fly?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
